description: Redirect mismatch boundaries reported as DIRECT errors. A multi-target client given a target matching none of its registrations is rejected with redirect_uri_mismatch. Under the default strict exact-match policy, a single-target client given a deeper sub-path of its registered host is also a direct mismatch (prefix is not enough when exact matching is required).

request.client_id: Test Client ID with Multiple Redirect Uris

cases.expected_output:
response=0
status=400
type=response
body.error=redirect_uri_mismatch
body.error_description=The redirect URI provided is missing or does not match
body.error_uri=http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6749#section-3.1.2
